# Scenes and movies

<!-- Generated by `coney-tools refs render` from research/references/scenes.yaml. Do not edit. -->

The in-engine scenes (cutscenes and animation sets, `.scn` records) and the full-motion movies
(`PSS/<name>.BIK`). `ScenePreload(name)` returns a scene id, the record's index in the global scene
list `scene_list.cnk`, which the other scene bindings take; `PlayMovie(name)` plays a movie.
How scenes play: [Scenes](../research/scenes.md); movies:
[Movies](../research/movies.md).

!!! info "What is complete"

    All 16 movies, and every scene of `scene_list.cnk` except the 1,525 segments that continue a longer
    scene: 1,240 scenes, 24 of them under names cut to 16 characters. A scene's levels and scripts are those that
    preload it by name; scenes that C++ code or a computed name loads show none.

    **Plays in** is the level whose world a scene plays in, for all 1,240 scenes: 309 named by a level's scripts
    (inferred from the scripts' strings: the scene list itself is global, [Scenes: which
    level](../research/scenes.md#which-level)), 3 more from a level's Subtitles chunk, 11 movie caption timings, 3 named
    only by a level's debug scene test, 7 from a level number at the end of the name and 663 from the `l<N>_` prefix
    alone (speculative: the prefix names the mission, and 19 of the 299 `l<N>_` scenes whose level the scripts or
    subtitles give play in the hub instead); 244 have no level (shared animation sets, subway scenes, and `l4_` /
    `l88_` names with no such level). **Cast** and **Props** are filled for the 188 scenes a script builds a scene
    table for: per role the character model of the human the script binds (inferred from its `HuCreate` type), per
    object slot the object type ([Scenes: cast and props](../research/scenes.md#cast)). `l99_c1`'s cast and the
    subway scenes `Coney_Sub2` and `Coney_Sub4`'s props were read at runtime
    ([Scenes: cast at runtime](../research/scenes.md#cast-runtime)).

1,256 entries. Data: `research/references/scenes.yaml`.

## Sources and evidence

Evidence levels used: confirmed-code.

- scene_list.cnk, the scripts' ScenePreload, the level records

## Fields

| Field | Type | Hand-written | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | str | | A scene's name; `movie:<name>` for a movie. |
| `kind` | str | | `movie` or `scene`. |
| `name` | str | | The name `PlayMovie` or `ScenePreload` takes. |
| `scene` | int | | Scene id: the record's index in `scene_list.cnk`, what `ScenePreload` returns. |
| `size` | int | | The scene record's size in bytes. |
| `levels` | list | | Levels whose scripts preload the scene by name. |
| `scripts` | list | | Scripts that preload it by name. |
| `plays_in` | list | yes | The level (or levels) whose world the scene plays in, as `plays_in_by` says how we know ([Scenes: which level](../research/scenes.md#which-level)). |
| `plays_in_by` | str | yes | How `plays_in` is known: `script` (a level's scripts name it), `subtitles` (its captions are in that level's `.lev`), `movie` (a movie's caption timing), `scenetest` (only a level's debug scene test names it), `suffix` or `prefix` (from the name alone), `none`. |
| `cast` | list | yes | Per role, in role order: the character model the scene's script binds to it (through `HuCreate`'s character type), `player` when it is the player, `-` when no human plays it, `?` when not resolved, `a\|b` when the script may bind either ([Scenes: cast](../research/scenes.md#cast)). |
| `props` | list | yes | Per object slot, in slot order: the object type the scene's script binds to it (the `ObjSpawn` type name), `-` when the script binds none, `?` when not resolved. |
| `played_by` | list | | What plays the movie: the boot, a level record's intro or outro, the front end. |
| `on_disc` | bool | | Whether the disc's `PSS` folder holds `<name>.BIK` (unknown for a disc image). |
| `source` | str | yes | Where the entry comes from: a script and binding, an address, a chunk. |
| `evidence` | str | yes | How we know: confirmed-code, confirmed-runtime, inferred or speculative ([evidence levels](../guides/research-workflow.md#evidence-levels)). |
| `notes` | str | yes | Our own short notes. |
